title: Jammed Dense Slovakian Flour Pilaf
description: A traditional Slovakian dish made with strong white flour, confit tomatoes, and garlic, prepared in a single pot and suitable for an ayurvedic sattvic diet. This recipe is a hearty and flavorful option for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and saute for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the confit tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the strong white flour and stir to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the salt, black pepper, and water, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
